sonnet.problem: The joke says the expert 'basically raised his hand to get INCLUDED.' The text gives no reason for his speaking up, and Luke 11:45 shows him complaining that he is being insulted, not asking to be included. The line adds a motive the text doesn't give and laughs at a person in the story.
sonnet.rule: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why. / Humor about people in Bible stories laughs with their human situation, never at them.
